item.title: Newark Mayor Condemns ICE After Pursuit Ends in Crash With Children Inside
item.description: "ICE has no business engaging in chases at any time, anywhere – but especially in densely populated areas, and on roads still being cleared from a significant snowstorm. ICE cannot come into our city and recklessly put innocent people in harm's way while they try to apprehend their targets." item.title: Brendan Gill Will Not Seek Reelection As County Commissioner
item.description: In an interview Friday, Gill said he decided not to run for reelection so he could spend more time with his family and focus on his public affairs business. While he had no plans to stop being an active Democrat, Gill said he would not be seeking elected office for the foreseeable future.
